merge.conflictsExpected_one: A conflict is expected in {{count}} file. You will be able to resolve it afterwards.
merge.conflictsExpected_other: Conflicts are expected in {{count}} files. You will be able to resolve them afterwards.

rebaseOnto.menu: Rebase the current branch onto this one
rebaseOnto.chooseDescription: Pick the branch on top of which you want to replay your commits.
rebaseOnto.title: Rebase {{current}} onto {{target}}
rebaseOnto.description: Replays your commits on top of the other branch to keep the history in a straight line.
rebaseOnto.incoming_one: on top of {{count}} new commit of the other branch.
rebaseOnto.incoming_other: on top of {{count}} new commits of the other branch.
rebaseOnto.upToDate: {{target}} is already included in your branch: there is nothing to move.
rebaseOnto.conflictsExpected_one: A conflict is expected in {{count}} file. You will be able to resolve it during the rebase.
rebaseOnto.conflictsExpected_other: Conflicts are expected in {{count}} files. You will be able to resolve them during the rebase.
rebaseOnto.keepMergesHint: Your branch has merges. If you leave it off, they are flattened into normal commits.
rebaseOnto.rewrites: This rewrites your commits. If you already pushed them you will need to send them with force-with-lease.
rebaseOnto.conflictTitle: There are conflicts in the rebase
rebaseOnto.conflictMessage: Resolve them in the Changes tab and continue from the banner above.

updates.upToDate: You already have the latest version ({{version}})
updates.notConfigured: Checking for new versions is not turned on in this build yet.

patches.chooseFolder: Choose the folder to save the patches in
patches.exported_one: Saved {{count}} patch in the chosen folder
patches.exported_other: Saved {{count}} patches in the chosen folder

done.workingTree_one: Applied the changes from the patch
done.workingTree_other: Applied the changes from the patches

patches.conflictTitle: The patch clashed with your changes
patches.conflictMessage: Resolve the conflicts and continue from the banner above.

dialog.description: Check what each patch changes before applying it.
dialog.doesNotFit: Does not apply as it is; git will try to merge it
dialog.needsMailbox: Some files carry no commit data, so they can only be applied as changes.

commit.label: Create one commit per patch
commit.hint: Keeps the author and message of each patch.

workingTree.label: Only apply the changes
workingTree.hint: Leaves the changes staged without committing. If they clash, they are marked as conflicts.

bisect.started: Search started. Try the commit that was opened and mark it.
bisect.finished: Search finished. You are back on your branch.

menu.bad: Bisect: this commit has the problem

dialog.title: Find the commit that broke something
dialog.description: Git will open commits in between. You try each one and say whether it is fine or broken, until the first failing one is found.
dialog.goodHint: An earlier commit where everything was fine. Accepts a hash, a branch or a tag.
dialog.cleanTree: You need to have no unsaved changes. When you finish you go back to your branch.

banner.title: Looking for the commit with the problem
banner.needMarks: Mark one good and one bad commit so git can narrow the search.
banner.progress: About {{steps}} steps left ({{count}} commits to check).
banner.foundTitle: This is the first commit with the problem

cleanup.title: Clean up the repository
cleanup.description: Tick what you want to remove. Nothing is deleted until you press Clean up and confirm.

files.title: Files not in Git
files.description: New files you never saved in a commit. Once deleted they cannot be recovered.

ignored.title: Ignored files
ignored.description: The ones your .gitignore leaves out, such as build folders. They can usually be generated again.

merged.title: Merged branches
merged.description: All their work is already in your current branch. The current branch, the main ones and those open in another worktree are not offered.

gone.title: Branches whose remote is gone
gone.description: Their branch on the server was deleted. If it was squash-merged, their commits are still separate here and would be lost.

stale.title: Stale remote branches
stale.description: Local copies of branches that no longer exist on the server. The server has to be asked to know.
stale.none: There are no stale remote branches.

confirm.title: Clean up the selection?
confirm.filesLoss_one: {{count}} file or folder will be deleted from disk; it does not go to the recycle bin.
confirm.filesLoss_other: {{count}} files or folders will be deleted from disk; they do not go to the recycle bin.
confirm.commitsLoss_one: {{count}} branch has commits that are in no other branch.
confirm.commitsLoss_other: {{count}} branches have commits that are in no other branch.

cleanup.done: Done: {{files}} files, {{branches}} local branches and {{pruned}} remote branches cleaned up.
cleanup.partial: Something could not be cleaned up

dialog.title: Profiles
dialog.description: A profile joins a GitHub account, an organization and your Git identity. When you pick it in a repository, commits carry that identity and changes are pushed with that account.
dialog.removeDescription: Repositories that use it no longer have a profile, but keep the name and email already written in them.

editor.title: Profile details
editor.label: Profile name
editor.labelHint: Short and easy to recognize, for example Work.
editor.orgsUnavailable: Your organizations could not be read.
editor.name: Name for commits
editor.signingUnavailable: Your signing keys could not be read.
editor.noAccounts: Connect a GitHub account in Settings to create a profile.

apply.title: Use the profile {{label}}
apply.description: In this repository commits will carry this identity and changes will be pushed with the account {{login}}.
apply.note: It is written to the local configuration of this repository. Your global Git configuration does not change.

hint.message: This repository belongs to {{owner}}. Use the profile "{{label}}"?

identity.label: Commit identity
identity.missing: Git has no name or email for this repository.
identity.mismatch: It does not match the profile "{{label}}".

picker.title: Switch profile
picker.forRepo: It will be applied to this repository.
picker.global: It will become your active profile.
